description: This is a source file written in TypeScript/JavaScript that scans other source files for specific raw fetch call patterns, mainly used for security guard purposes. It imports utility modules, defines functions for locating raw fetch calls, and runs a guard process.

methods.name: isRawFetchCall
methods.description: Checks if a given expression node is a fetch call, either directly or a property access of globalThis.fetch.

methods.name: findRawFetchCallLines
methods.description: Creates a TypeScript source file object from content and finds line numbers where raw fetch calls occur.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the callsite guard process, scanning specified directories for raw fetch calls outside the allowlist.
